title: Principal eigenvalue of a Neumann elliptic operator
problem: Let Ω be a bounded connected C² domain, d>0 and q∈C(Ω̄). For L=dΔ+q with homogeneous Neumann boundary condition, characterize the largest eigenvalue by the Rayleigh quotient, show it has a strictly positive eigenfunction and is simple, and show monotonicity under a pointwise increase in q.

offline_scenario.literature_notes: Fixture: compact self-adjoint elliptic spectral theory and the strong maximum principle.

methods.name: Variational and positivity argument
methods.rationale: Use the Rayleigh supremum, elliptic regularity and positivity.

steps.goal: Set up the Neumann realization and Rayleigh quotient
Obtain the largest eigenvalue and eigenfunction
